## Workload

During the quarter, grader Hannah Lowe completed 626 reads over 288 hours, averaging 2.2 reads per hour. This workload reflects the activity recorded for the review period.

## Quality

A sample of 44 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 56.8 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in grading and highlight areas requiring further consideration.
